Castlevania: Belmont's Curse - "Bloody Tears" Gameplay Trailer
Castlevania: Belmont's Curse will be released on October 15th, 2026 (Thursday), and pre-orders are now being accepted! In 1499, as the bells announcing the end of medieval Paris ring out, the French capital is under attack by a horde of monsters that have suddenly appeared. 

Trevor Belmont, the hero who killed Dracula and wields the sacred whip "Vampire Killer," and his daughter Rose Belmont, begin exploring the city and hunting down the monsters to uncover the source of this calamity. Rose soon finds herself entangled in a dark conspiracy lurking behind it all. Can she save Paris?

Tune in to KONAMI PRESS START, for a showcase featuring the latest news and updates on Konami's upcoming projects and current available titles, including SILENT HILL: Townfall, Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse, and Rev. NOiR.

text:
PlayStation State of Play Livestream (September 3, 2026)
Tune in on Thursday, September 3rd at 6am PT / 9am ET for two State of Play broadcasts airing back-to-back.

Firstly the State of Play will feature updates and announcements from PlayStation Studios and third-party partners, concluding with an extended look at the vast world of Final Fantasy VII Revelation from our friends at Square Enix.

Right after the State of Play ends tune in for a new episode of State of Play Japan, which will be hosted by Yuki Kaji. State of Play Japan will showcase upcoming games from game studios in Japan and Asia, including new gameplay, announcements, news and more.

Watch both broadcasts live on September 3 starting at 6:00am PT / 9:00am ET / 3:00pm CEST / 10:00pm JST on YouTube and Twitch. State of Play will air in English, with Japanese subtitles also available. State of Play Japan will air in Japanese, with English subtitles available.

text:
Until Dawn 2 - Choice & Consequence Pre-Order Gameplay Trailer
The Dead True ghost-hunting crew are chasing their biggest story yet. After an investigation at Blackwood Sanitorium takes a chilling turn, an encounter with supernatural survivor Yoona leads them to Akishima Island, a remote paradise abandoned for decades and hiding secrets far older than any of them imagined.

As the night unfolds, your choices will decide what happens next. Follow a signal in search of a missing friend, or risk a detour that could uncover vital clues. Make the sacrifice you’re told to make, or choose another way. Every decision can change the story, and determine who survives.

Until Dawn 2 launches January 28, 2027 on PS5.
Pre-order the Standard or Digital Deluxe Edition from September 10 to unlock Dr. Hill-themed content. The Digital Deluxe Edition also includes the Y2K Neon Vibes Pack and Dioramas of Death extra feature.

Everyone Can Live. Everyone Can Die.
